C1809.title: Knightscope K5 Security Robot Mall Collision Incident
C1809.summary: In July 2016, the Knightscope K5 security robot (1.5 m tall, 136 kg) knocked down a 16-month-old toddler at a Stanford shopping center, causing leg scrapes and foot swelling. In July 2017 the robot fell into a fountain in Washington Harbor due to an autonomous-driving algorithm error; in 2019 a Huntington Park alert button failed to reach police. The incidents highlight service-robot physical-harm risk and functional-safety deficiencies in human-robot mixed environments, driving ISO 13482 personal-care robot safety attention.
